gloss: worth seeing; visual impact; impressive sight

definitions.explanation: The quality of being visually impressive, substantial, and satisfying to watch.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{見応|みごた}えがある。
{見応|みごた}えのある{試合|しあい}だった。
{桜|さくら}が{満開|まんかい}で{見応|みごた}え{十分|じゅうぶん}だ。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms are in full bloom and are truly a sight to see.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{見|み}る (to see) + {応|こた}え (response/worth) → worth seeing

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{見応|みごた}えがある (is worth seeing, is visually impressive)
・{見応|みごた}えのある{展覧会|てんらんかい} (an exhibition worth seeing)
・{見応|みごた}え{十分|じゅうぶん} (fully impressive to watch)

RELATED ～{応|ごた}え WORDS:
・{読|よ}み{応|ごた}え (worth reading)
・{聞|き}き{応|ごた}え (worth listening to)
・{歯応|はごた}え (chewiness; challenge)
・{手応|てごた}え (response; feedback)

USAGE:
Used for movies, performances, sports matches, natural scenery, art exhibitions—anything visual that provides satisfaction.
